product_one_liner.value: Talowiz is an AI hiring platform for recruiting and talent-acquisition teams that autonomously sources, evaluates, interviews, and selects candidates to automate recruitment workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: Talowiz’s homepage describes its AI agents as autonomously sourcing, evaluating, interviewing, and selecting talent, and presents this as automation of recruiting workflows for talent acquisition.

pricing_page.notes: The Talowiz pricing page publicly lists plans and prices, and its homepage footer links to Pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage testimonials identify Vedantu and GoodGist as client organizations. | named_customers.0: The company homepage testimonial names GoodGist. | named_customers.1: The company homepage testimonial identifies Vedantu.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company record gives an employee count of 15, and Tracxn reports 15 as of May 31, 2026; 15 falls in the 11–20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: LinkedIn explicitly labels Ashburn as headquarters and Dealroom also lists Ashburn. Talowiz’s legal/contact address is in San Jose, so the city is not perfectly consistent; I use the repeated explicit headquarters listing. | hq_country: The LinkedIn company profile and Dealroom both place Talowiz in the United States; the country is consistent even though sources differ on the city.

founded_year.notes: Talowiz’s LinkedIn company profile says it was founded in 2022; PitchBook reports 2021, so I use the first-party company profile while noting the conflicting directory date.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index is a resource library whose listed posts are recruitment guidance, hiring strategy, and user-facing product explainers; it does not show at least two engineer-authored articles about how Talowiz is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage footer’s quick links include comparison, pricing, and blog links plus Terms and Privacy, but no public documentation or help-center link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Talowiz jobs listing states as of November 9, 2026 that there are no open positions, so there is no open AI/ML/data-science role.

model_provider.notes: Talowiz’s privacy policy says it developed a custom AI model; it names no external model provider, so the supported answer is Talowiz’s own custom model.

compliance_certs.notes: Talowiz’s legal policy describes confidentiality and encryption and refers to GDPR in the context of data-protection duties, but does not claim any of the listed certifications; GDPR is discussed as a regulation, not as a Talowiz certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook identifies a completed Early Stage VC deal and CB Insights associates Talowiz with an investor, FortyTwo VC, but Dealroom and Tracxn report no known external rounds. The available record supports the displayed stage, while the funding date and amount are not disclosed and the sources conflict.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Talowiz jobs listing says there are no open positions as of November 9, 2026, so it is not hiring an SDR, BDR, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The visible LinkedIn Launch Alert is marked eight months old, before the six-month window, and the latest dated homepage/blog items shown are from March and February 2026. No qualifying in-window dated launch announcement is shown; this is medium confidence because a newer product landing page exists without a clear dated launch announcement.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Talowiz’s privacy policy says it uses Google Analytics to track website traffic and Mailchimp to manage newsletters and transactional email; these are the named sales/marketing systems found in the reviewed material. | crm_stack_signal.0: The privacy policy states that Google Analytics is used to track website traffic. | crm_stack_signal.1: The privacy policy states that Mailchimp is used to manage newsletters and transactional emails.
